dateRules.executionStartedAtEndedAt: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; UI inputs use browser local datetime
dateRules.taskDay: YYYY-MM-DD browser-local calendar date, defaults to selected day
dateRules.dailyView: selectedDay defaults to current browser-local date; plan period includes selectedDay; tasks filtered by day
dateRules.comparison: Default SEE includes all tasks in selected plan and their linked executions. Optional from/to dates filter task day and execution start date separately. Estimated and actual are sums in minutes; missing estimates count as zero. Difference = actual - estimated.
dateRules.overdue: Asia/Seoul calendar date; only unfinished tasks with due date before today are overdue.

document.plans: array of plan objects, including revisions
document.tasks: array of task objects linked by planId; day YYYY-MM-DD local execution date; due optional deadline; priority-desc is default sort (high, normal, low); estimated duration stored in total minutes.
document.executions: array of execution records linked by taskId and planId; isCompletion=true unique per task by application logic; server rejects multiple isCompletion records for the same taskId.
document.reflections: array of reflections linked to source/next plan; nextPlanId connects improvement memo to the target plan.

security.note: No login in T06; anyone with deployed URL may read/write public data.
